#On Sigil Stones

Every stone torn from a sigil tower carries one enchantment, burned in by the Daedra who fed it. You cannot choose it. You can only choose what you give it to.

#The Binding

Hold the stone in your sword hand. Hold the thing you want enchanted in the other. Then will it, the way you would will a door to open.

The stone crumbles to warm grit. The enchantment stays.

It won't bind to something that can't take it: a fire-ward won't sit in a sword, and a blade's edge won't sit in a boot.
